# ===================================================================
# GOOD SCRIPTED BLOCK EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates CORRECT CK3 scripted effect and trigger usage.
# All examples in this file should PASS validation with NO errors.
#
# What this tests:
# - Scripted effect definitions and usage
# - Scripted trigger definitions and usage
# - Parameterized scripted effects ($PARAM$ syntax)
# - Scripted effects calling other scripted effects (non-recursive)
#
# NOTE: In a real mod, definitions go in common/scripted_effects/
# and common/scripted_triggers/. Usage goes in events/.
# Both are shown here for demonstration purposes.
#
# Expected validation result: NO ERRORS
# ===================================================================

# ===================================================================
# DEFINITIONS (as they would appear in common/scripted_effects/)
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Definition 1: Simple scripted effect
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Basic scripted effect definition
# DEMONSTRATES: A reusable effect that grants rewards
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
grant_standard_reward_effect = {
	add_gold = 100
	add_prestige = 50
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Definition 2: Parameterized scripted effect ($PARAM$ syntax)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Scripted effect with parameter substitution
# DEMONSTRATES: $PARAM$ syntax for flexible scripted effects
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
grant_scaled_reward_effect = {
	add_gold = $GOLD_AMOUNT$
	add_prestige = $PRESTIGE_AMOUNT$
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Definition 3: Scripted effect that calls another scripted effect
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Non-recursive composition of scripted effects
# DEMONSTRATES: One scripted effect calling a different one
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
full_victory_reward_effect = {
	grant_standard_reward_effect = yes
	add_piety = 25
}

# ===================================================================
# DEFINITIONS (as they would appear in common/scripted_triggers/)
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Definition 4: Simple scripted trigger
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Basic scripted trigger definition
# DEMONSTRATES: A reusable trigger checking eligibility
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
is_eligible_hero_trigger = {
	is_adult = yes
	is_ruler = yes
	is_alive = yes
}

# ===================================================================
# USAGE (as they would appear in events/)
# ===================================================================

namespace = scripted_good

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 1: Using a scripted effect in an event
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Calling a defined scripted effect
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - effect is defined above
# DEMONSTRATES: Standard scripted effect invocation
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
scripted_good.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scripted_good.0001.t
	desc = scripted_good.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = scripted_good.0001.a
		grant_standard_reward_effect = yes
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 2: Using a scripted trigger in an event
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Calling a defined scripted trigger
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - trigger is defined above
# DEMONSTRATES: Standard scripted trigger invocation
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
scripted_good.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scripted_good.0002.t
	desc = scripted_good.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_eligible_hero_trigger = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = scripted_good.0002.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 3: Using parameterized scripted effect
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Calling a scripted effect with $PARAM$ values
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - effect defined with parameters, invoked with values
# DEMONSTRATES: Parameter passing to scripted effects
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
scripted_good.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scripted_good.0003.t
	desc = scripted_good.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = scripted_good.0003.a
		grant_scaled_reward_effect = {
			GOLD_AMOUNT = 200
			PRESTIGE_AMOUNT = 100
		}
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 4: Using composed scripted effect (non-recursive)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Using an effect that internally calls another effect
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - full_victory_reward_effect calls grant_standard_reward_effect (not itself)
# DEMONSTRATES: Safe effect composition without recursion
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
scripted_good.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = scripted_good.0004.t
	desc = scripted_good.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_eligible_hero_trigger = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = scripted_good.0004.a
		full_victory_reward_effect = yes
	}
}
